description: Every spoken word with its number, its start and end seconds on the video's clock and its source number, paged. Word numbers are what cut takes, source numbers what fix_captions lines take; seconds place overlays, graphics and sounds on what is said. Cost: Free: no credits.

base_version.description: A version_id to read; the live version when left out.

count.description: How many words, 1 to 2000; 500 when left out.

from_word.description: The first word number to read; 0 when left out.

output_id.description: An output (Short, hook, shape); the main video when left out.

name: get_transcript

outputSchema.description: Clypmint get_transcript result. Error results carry error; successful requests expose the identifiers and state available for the next step. Signed media stays in private metadata.

title: Read the spoken words
